## Scorecard receipt (Scorecard Law, five steps)

1. **Enumerate:** <!-- every option considered, including "do nothing" -->
2. **Score:** <!-- each option scored on value, consequences, mission/vision alignment, situational awareness -->
3. **Gate:** <!-- reversible? no major damage? positive forward effect? hard stops checked -->
4. **Decide:** <!-- the winner, the strongest alternative, and what would falsify the choice -->
5. **Receipt:** <!-- this PR body + feed sign in/out references. No receipt, no merge. -->
